t: You're at the Diana, Princess of Wales Memorial Playground, in the north western corner of Kensington Gardens. It opened in 2000 and sits beside the Broad Walk, in sight of Kensington Palace, where the Princess used to live. It is a memorial to Diana, who was the first wife of Charles the Third and the mother of Princes William and Harry. Her activism and glamour made her an international icon, and her popularity endures.
